result.rationale: Low-energy inversion ankle sprain in a healthy 29-year-old with all Ottawa ankle rule criteria negative (no malleolar or midfoot bone tenderness, able to bear weight for four steps immediately and now), mild swelling, no wound, numbness, or deformity. Appropriate for home care: rest, ice, compression, elevation, over-the-counter analgesics, and gradual return to activity, with reassessment if pain/swelling worsens, weight-bearing becomes impossible, or symptoms fail to improve within several days.
